summary: Neshoba County, MS: lattice observation tower carrying the Sandtown name (about 190 m). Only OpenStreetMap and Wikipedia found; no history or current-status record.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Sources: the OSM node (tags: lattice, observation; ele 190; last edited over a year ago) and the Wikipedia article on the Sandtown community. Cached OSM data gives gnis:feature_id 711308 for the tower; GNIS pages are JavaScript-only here and were not read. Neither source gives the tower's history. A state public-lands list dated July 29, 2020 includes a 'Neshoba County Tower' entry; it names no town and is not linked to this record. The story does not place the tower relative to the community, because no source does; the name is the only link. Two WebSearch calls found nothing on a Sandtown tower. Record status and access are unknown and the story says so. The story is about 110 words, below the usual 120-word floor, because the evidence is thin. Page-read budget was exceeded (about 8 fetches, including repeats).
